name: @lenso/tokens
description: Apple semantic colors and Lenso Web materials with StyleX.

scripts.build: bun run generate:theme && bun src/components/typography/generate-prose.ts && bun ./node_modules/tsdown/dist/run.mjs --config tsdown.config.ts && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noEmit false --outDir dist && bun scripts/copy-css.ts
scripts.build:dev: bun run generate:theme && bun src/components/typography/generate-prose.ts && bun ./node_modules/tsdown/dist/run.mjs --config tsdown.config.ts && bun scripts/copy-css.ts
scripts.test: bun run generate:theme --check && bun src/components/typography/generate-prose.ts --check && bun test tests/*.test.ts
